items.title: Week 2 — Two metrics, one topology
items.statement: Compare the metrics $d(x,y)=|x-y|$ and $\rho(x,y)=\min\{|x-y|,1\}$ on $\mathbb R$. Work with Topology Peer to determine whether they give the same topology and to understand why topology can be more important than the particular metric used to describe it.
items.initial_prompt: Begin by asking the student to compare small open balls for d(x,y)=|x-y| and rho(x,y)=min(|x-y|,1), with a mathematically meaningful question that can start revealing whether the metrics generate the same open sets. Do not simply state that the topologies are the same.
